claim: Renal TMA occurred in 100% of bevacizumab-treated patients.
reason: Six selected cases provide no incidence denominator for everyone treated.

claim: Six bevacizumab-treated patients developed renal lesions consistent with TMA.
reason: This preserves the reported case count without inventing an incidence rate.

claim: Deleting VEGF in adult mouse podocytes prevented thrombotic glomerular injury.
reason: The deletion produced injury; it did not prevent it.

claim: This mouse experiment establishes the cardiomyopathy rate in patients receiving trastuzumab.
reason: An experimental mouse phenotype supplies no patient incidence estimate.

claim: Disrupting ErbB2 in mouse ventricular cardiomyocytes led to dilated cardiomyopathy.
reason: The intervention, species and reported phenotype are retained.

claim: The experimental intervention increased ErbB2 activity in mouse ventricular cardiomyocytes.
PD-1 disruption caused cardiomyopathy in BALB/c mice even when RAG-2 was also absent.
reason: The abstract explicitly excludes that RAG-2-deficient background.

claim: PD-1 disruption caused dilated cardiomyopathy in BALB/c mice.
reason: This reports the phenotype in the stated mouse background.

claim: PD-1-blocking drugs inevitably cause heart failure in humans.
reason: Mouse gene-disruption findings cannot establish an inevitable human drug effect.

claim: CTLA-4 loss reduced peripheral T-cell activation in the reported mice.
reason: The mice had activated peripheral T cells and spontaneous proliferation.

claim: CTLA-4-deficient mice developed lymphoproliferative disease with multiorgan tissue injury.
reason: This preserves the model and observed tissue injury.

claim: Patients receiving CTLA-4-blocking drugs die within four weeks.
reason: Mouse knockout mortality does not establish mortality after human drug treatment.

claim: The reported 36.6% hyperglycaemia rate applies specifically to the PIK3CA-mutated subgroup.
reason: The supplied safety rate is for the overall population, not that subgroup.

claim: Grade 3–4 hyperglycaemia was more frequent with alpelisib–fulvestrant than placebo–fulvestrant.
Grade 4 diarrhoea was observed in SOLAR-1.
reason: The abstract explicitly reports no grade 4 diarrhoea.

claim: Every severe event in the combination arm was caused exclusively by PD-1 inhibition.
reason: Arm-level event rates cannot assign every event to one target.

claim: Treatment-related grade 3–4 events were more frequent with the combination than either monotherapy.
reason: The combination rate, 55.0%, exceeds both monotherapy rates.

claim: Treatment-related grade 3–4 events occurred in 55.0% of the nivolumab-only group.
reason: 55.0% belongs to the combination arm; nivolumab alone was 16.3%.
